products.title: 90° Metric Male O-Ring
products.focusKeyword: 90 metric male o-ring
products.descriptionShort: 90° Metric Male O-Ring — metric adapter, 90 elbow body, 12 orderable sizes on this page. RFQ-only; standard Indus zinc-plated carbon-steel construction.
products.descriptionLong:
The 90° Metric Male O-Ring is a 90 elbow hydraulic adapter in the Indus metric range. Every size the manufacturer publishes is listed in the Sizes & Part Numbers tab, with the thread on each end, the dimensions and the part number to quote.

Construction

  • Body configuration: 90 elbow
  • Port A: 90° Metric Male O-Ring
  • Material: carbon steel (stainless steel available on request)
  • Surface treatment: zinc-plated, Cr3+ passivated, RoHS-compliant

Threads

  • Port A: Metric M12×1.25 to M52×2

Sealing

Metric O-ring stud end. Match the seat as well as the thread — a thread that engages against the wrong seat will weep under pressure, and several of these families share a thread while sealing differently.

Performance

The manufacturer publishes no pressure rating for this family. Tell us the working pressure your line sees and we will confirm the fitting is rated for it before you order.

Applicable standards

ISO 6149.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number from the size table. If you have only the ports, send us the thread on each end and whether you need carbon steel or stainless, and Indus engineering will confirm the part number against your equipment.

Companion products

These are tube and port adapters, not hose ends. For hose assemblies pair them with Indus crimp ferrules and the matching hose-end fitting; for tube runs, with Indus cutting rings and end nuts.
products.seoTitle: 90° Metric Male O-Ring

faqs.question: What thread family does this adapter use?
faqs.answer: metric. ISO 6149. The seat is metric O-ring stud end. Check the thread on each end against the size table before ordering.

faqs.question: What are the port specs?
faqs.answer: Port A: 90° Metric Male O-Ring. Port A: Metric M12×1.25 to M52×2.

faqs.question: What sizes are available?
faqs.answer: 12 sizes are listed, covering -12 to -52. The Sizes & Part Numbers tab gives the thread on each end, the dimensions and the Indus part number for every one. Sizes outside the table are quoted on request.

faqs.question: What is the maximum working pressure?
faqs.answer: The manufacturer publishes no pressure rating for this family, so this page does not state one. Tell us the working pressure your line sees and we will confirm the fitting is rated for it before you order.

faqs.question: What materials and finishes are available?
faqs.answer: Standard: carbon steel with a zinc-plated, Cr3+ passivated, RoHS-compliant finish. 316 stainless steel is available on request for marine, chemical or food-grade service — add "-SS" to the part number when you enquire.

faqs.question: Is this adapter interchangeable with other thread families?
faqs.answer: No. metric is a thread family in its own right and does not interchange with BSP, JIC, NPT, metric or ORFS. Where you need to cross between families, use the adapter built for that pair rather than forcing a thread that nearly fits.

faqs.question: Do I need to crimp this onto a hose?
faqs.answer: No. These are tube and port adapters, not hose ends — they thread into a port or join two threaded ends. For a hose assembly use Indus crimp ferrules with the matching Indus hose-end fitting.

faqs.question: Lead time?
faqs.answer: Common sizes are held in Jebel Ali and go out the same day if you order before 14:00 GST. Less-common combinations ship within 7 working days of RFQ confirmation; say if it is a plant-down job and we will prioritise it.

products.descriptionShort: Metric Bite Type Elbow Pump Flange Connection — DIN 2353 bite-type adapter, 90 elbow body, 11 orderable sizes on this page. RFQ-only; standard Indus zinc-plated carbon-steel construction.
products.descriptionLong:
The Metric Bite Type Elbow Pump Flange Connection is a 90 elbow hydraulic adapter in the Indus DIN 2353 bite-type range. Every size the manufacturer publishes is listed in the Sizes & Part Numbers tab, with the thread on each end, the dimensions and the part number to quote.

Construction

  • Body configuration: 90 elbow
  • Port A: Elbow Pump Flange Connection
  • Material: carbon steel (stainless steel available on request)
  • Surface treatment: zinc-plated, Cr3+ passivated, RoHS-compliant

Threads

  • Port A: Metric M16×1.5 to M24×1.5
  • Port B: Metric M6×22/M6×35 to M6×22/M6×45

Sealing

SAE flange face with O-ring. Match the seat as well as the thread — a thread that engages against the wrong seat will weep under pressure, and several of these families share a thread while sealing differently.

Performance

The manufacturer publishes no pressure rating for this family. Tell us the working pressure your line sees and we will confirm the fitting is rated for it before you order.

Applicable standards

ISO 6162.

Light and heavy series

Both the light and the heavy series are listed on this page. They share a nominal size but not a tube outside diameter, so pick the row by the tube O.D. column, not by the thread alone.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number from the size table. If you have only the ports, send us the thread on each end and whether you need carbon steel or stainless, and Indus engineering will confirm the part number against your equipment.

Companion products

These are tube and port adapters, not hose ends. For hose assemblies pair them with Indus crimp ferrules and the matching hose-end fitting; for tube runs, with Indus cutting rings and end nuts.

products.descriptionShort: 90° Elbow Metric Male 74° Cone Bulkhead — metric adapter, 90 elbow bulkhead body, 12 orderable sizes on this page. RFQ-only; standard Indus zinc-plated carbon-steel construction.
products.descriptionLong:
The 90° Elbow Metric Male 74° Cone Bulkhead is a 90 elbow bulkhead hydraulic adapter in the Indus metric range. Every size the manufacturer publishes is listed in the Sizes & Part Numbers tab, with the thread on each end, the dimensions, the weight and the working pressure.

Construction

  • Body configuration: 90 elbow bulkhead
  • Port A: Metric Male 74° Cone
  • Material: carbon steel (stainless steel available on request)
  • Surface treatment: zinc-plated, Cr3+ passivated, RoHS-compliant

Threads

  • Port A: Metric M12×1.5 to M45×2
  • Port B: Metric M12×1.5 to M45×2

Sealing

Metric 37° cone (74° included). Match the seat as well as the thread — a thread that engages against the wrong seat will weep under pressure, and several of these families share a thread while sealing differently.

Performance

The manufacturer states 100 to 350 bar depending on size, printed against every size in the table. That is the rating of the adapter; an assembly is limited by whichever component is rated lowest — the hose, the tube or the port.

Applicable standards

ISO 8434-2 profile, metric thread.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number from the size table. If you have only the ports, send us the thread on each end and whether you need carbon steel or stainless, and Indus engineering will confirm the part number against your equipment.

Companion products

These are tube and port adapters, not hose ends. For hose assemblies pair them with Indus crimp ferrules and the matching hose-end fitting; for tube runs, with Indus cutting rings and end nuts.

faqs.question: What thread family does this adapter use?
faqs.answer: metric. ISO 8434-2 profile, metric thread. The seat is metric 37° cone (74° included). Check the thread on each end against the size table before ordering.

faqs.question: What are the port specs?
faqs.answer: Port A: Metric Male 74° Cone. Port A: Metric M12×1.5 to M45×2. Port B: Metric M12×1.5 to M45×2.

faqs.question: What sizes are available?
faqs.answer: 12 sizes are listed, covering -12 to -45. The Sizes & Part Numbers tab gives the thread on each end, the dimensions and the Indus part number for every one. Sizes outside the table are quoted on request.

faqs.question: What is the maximum working pressure?
faqs.answer: The manufacturer states 100 to 350 bar depending on size, and the figure is printed against each size in the table. The rating of an assembly tracks its lowest-rated component, so check it against the hose, the tube and the port you are mating to.

faqs.question: What materials and finishes are available?
faqs.answer: Standard: carbon steel with a zinc-plated, Cr3+ passivated, RoHS-compliant finish. 316 stainless steel is available on request for marine, chemical or food-grade service — add "-SS" to the part number when you enquire.

faqs.question: Is this adapter interchangeable with other thread families?
faqs.answer: No. metric is a thread family in its own right and does not interchange with BSP, JIC, NPT, metric or ORFS. Where you need to cross between families, use the adapter built for that pair rather than forcing a thread that nearly fits.

faqs.question: Do I need to crimp this onto a hose?
faqs.answer: No. These are tube and port adapters, not hose ends — they thread into a port or join two threaded ends. For a hose assembly use Indus crimp ferrules with the matching Indus hose-end fitting.

faqs.question: Lead time?
faqs.answer: Common sizes are held in Jebel Ali and go out the same day if you order before 14:00 GST. Less-common combinations ship within 7 working days of RFQ confirmation; say if it is a plant-down job and we will prioritise it.

products.descriptionLong:
The JIS Metric Male 60° Cone is a straight hydraulic adapter in the Indus metric range. Every size the manufacturer publishes is listed in the Sizes & Part Numbers tab, with the thread on each end, the dimensions and the part number to quote.

Construction

  • Body configuration: straight
  • Port A: JIS Metric Male 60° Cone
  • Material: carbon steel (stainless steel available on request)
  • Surface treatment: zinc-plated, Cr3+ passivated, RoHS-compliant

Threads

  • Port A: Metric M14×1.5 to M42×1.5
  • Port B: Metric M14×1.5 to M42×1.5

Sealing

JIS 30° cone (60° included), metric thread. Match the seat as well as the thread — a thread that engages against the wrong seat will weep under pressure, and several of these families share a thread while sealing differently.

Performance

The manufacturer publishes no pressure rating for this family. Tell us the working pressure your line sees and we will confirm the fitting is rated for it before you order.

Applicable standards

JIS B8363.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number from the size table. If you have only the ports, send us the thread on each end and whether you need carbon steel or stainless, and Indus engineering will confirm the part number against your equipment.

Companion products

These are tube and port adapters, not hose ends. For hose assemblies pair them with Indus crimp ferrules and the matching hose-end fitting; for tube runs, with Indus cutting rings and end nuts.
